# beenfar_network (Data Source)

Looks up a network by id or name, e.g. one managed in the UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A network created in the UI.
data "beenfar_network" "lan" {
  name = "lan"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Network id. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) Network name. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.

### Read-Only

- `dhcp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether DHCP is served.
- `dhcp_start` (String) First address of the DHCP pool.
- `dhcp_stop` (String) Last address of the DHCP pool.
- `domain_name` (String) DNS domain handed to clients.
- `subnet` (String) Gateway address and prefix length.
- `vlan_id` (Number) 802.1Q VLAN id; 0 when untagged.
